title: Scripture God-breathed; how to read (Philoc. 1 opening)
english: The anthology opens from Origen on the [[God-breathed >> Bible:2 Timothy 3:16]] character of the divine writings and how they are to be read and understood — including why obscurity and passages impossible or absurd at the mere letter are there, so that we seek the Spirit’s sense without despising what the letter rightly carries.
translator_notes: Copy-text Robinson 1893 Philocalia TEI (origen_tlg019.xml); no George Lewis 1911 wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
